maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The identified keypoints are arranged in a linear horizontal row, positioned approximately 1.5 times their average diameter superior to the primary dense vibrissae row, with a parallel orientation to the upper lip line.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95% dark melanin saturation observed across the visible surface of the rhinarium, with localized pink/pale pixels limited to the extreme inferior-lateral margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Observed minor irregular serration/notching on the superior-lateral margin of the visible ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark pigment stripes (malar stripes) extending from the medial canthus towards the maxillary region.
